colony at Fort Tusken. The massacre ultimately failed to force settlers to leave

The average Tusken Raider fears machines. The whine of a Speeder or Swoop usually foretells the approach of murderous offworlders, and even the bravest Tusken Raider must think twice before facing such foes.
